workflowDependentDue.heading: Step timing
workflowDependentDue.copy: Set when this step is due and whether earlier steps must be finished first.
workflowDependentDue.sequential: Require steps to be completed in order
workflowDependentDue.waiting: The due time will appear when its saved starting point is available.
workflowDependentDue.blocked: An earlier step must be finished before this one can be completed.
workflowDependentDue.saveFailed: The step timing could not be saved. Try again.
